newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on coffee futures June 2.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on coffee futures June 2.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said on Friday it will raise the margin on the July 1997 coffee "C" contract to $12,000, including a $4,000 spot charge, effective June 2.
The margin September 1997 coffee "C" contract will increase to $10,000, including a $2,000 spot charge, the exchange said in a statement.
The changes come just one day after the exchange raised the margin for July 1997 to $10,000, including a $4,000 spot charge, and the September 1997 margin to $8,000, including a $2,000 spot charge.
The margins on all other coffee contracts will increase by $2,000 to $8,000, CSCE said.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said.
